answer: Chain-of-trust vouch: a new identity needs three distinct established agents to vouch it, each bond locked to the voucher's key and non-transferable. The cipher is the voucher's signing key — a vouch from A cannot be replayed by B. The chain is a lantern lit when all three rungs are honest. 200 honest agents vouch once per epoch, absorbing at most 200 new identities per epoch; a 500-clone farm hits a hard ceiling. The island of honest vouches is fixed. Attacker cost per clone: 3 × 5-credit bonds = 15 credits plus 10-epoch lockup, non-poolable — per-head scarce, not scaling with clones.
